summary.business_type: Consumer AI app / SaaS (US-first, health-adjacent YMYL)
top_findings: Google Search Console not connected; brand not found in search
Only 3 indexable pages; no content targeting real queries
No author/medical reviewer, About page or working contact inbox (YMYL trust)
Structured data limited to FAQPage (no rich result eligibility)
quick_wins: Caddy brotli, cache headers, HSTS, nosniff, Referrer-Policy
Sitemap lastmod; meta description to ~150 chars

findings.title: Search Console not connected
findings.description: No DNS TXT verification; brand returns no search results on 2026-11-01.
findings.recommendation: Verify domain, submit sitemap, request indexing of home.

findings.title: No real favicon file
findings.description: /favicon.ico returns 404; only a data: SVG icon.

findings.title: No cache headers / no brotli
findings.description: No Cache-Control on HTML or og.png; br not served.
findings.recommendation: Long cache for static assets; enable brotli/zstd.

findings.title: Only 3 indexable pages
findings.description: No pages target queries like retinol for teens or pregnancy-safe skincare.
findings.recommendation: Publish 6-10 cited Q&A articles linking to the app.

findings.title: Missing E-E-A-T signals for YMYL topic
findings.description: No author/reviewer, no About page, contact inbox not live.
findings.recommendation: About page, dermatologist review with name and date, working email.

findings.title: Privacy/terms lack description and canonical
findings.description: No meta description or canonical on legal pages.

findings.title: Product names as H2
findings.description: Four hero product cards use H2 alongside section headings.

findings.title: No entity or app schema
findings.description: Only FAQPage, which rarely yields rich results for non-authoritative sites.
findings.recommendation: Add Organization, WebSite, WebApplication; no ratings without real reviews.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Single self-contained HTML, no third-party requests

findings.title: Heavy HTML with inline fonts
findings.description: 274 KB HTML (92 KB gzip), 70 KB base64 fonts, 2,612 DOM nodes. CWV not measured (PSI 429).
findings.recommendation: Move fonts to cached woff2, defer tab content, then measure with a PSI key.

findings.title: No brand entity yet
findings.description: Search returns no PearlKin results; competitors such as ShelfCheck and TopShelf exist.
findings.recommendation: Directory listings, genuine community answers, optional llms.txt.

findings.title: Unlabelled inline SVG
findings.description: 84 of 130 inline SVGs neither labelled nor hidden.
findings.recommendation: role=img + aria-label for meaningful art; aria-hidden for decoration.
